# Repository frontend instructions

For every frontend/layout task, read and follow:

`skills/web-layout/SKILL.md`

This is the shared layout standard for responsive geometry, sticky navigation, image proportions, media fallback, overflow control and production QA.

For the CSUM Nizhny Novgorod editorial branch, also follow:
`skills/csum-editorial-writer/SKILL.md`

Do not solve layout defects with isolated magic offsets, arbitrary z-index values, image stretching, iframe embedding, or global overflow clipping.
